hypothesis: Some complete table tests compute their expected result from the current input. Whole-column rotations can create new pairings while retaining that dynamic observation. Column independence and valid-domain constraints still require complete-test review.

semantic_policy.ordering: source candidate ranks round robin over sorted trial names
semantic_policy.interrupted_dispatch: unknown with reserved cost; no retry
semantic_policy.unknown: not executed; not an invalid test judgment

ordering: retrieval_rank, source path, test start, table start, shift, column
stop: First controlled failure, then one repeat; stop even if the repeat does not confirm.

policy.construction: Rotate one anonymous struct table column by a nonzero cyclic shift. Preserve all rows and the complete original test. Each changed cell is an exact input edit.
policy.ordering: retrieval_rank, source path, test start, table start, shift, column
policy.domain: Original module-level Test functions; unique direct local []struct table and range row; positional equal-width rows; unshadowed builtin scalar types and closed literal cells.
policy.roles: Require a direct field use at a stable source or import call argument outside known oracle-only regions. Diagnostic or expected-only columns do not qualify. Shared input/oracle columns may qualify.
policy.oracle: Full test, all assertions, helpers and other input columns remain unchanged. A dynamic expected expression does not prove arbitrary column independence.
limitations: Table and row aliases, rebinding, mutation, address-taking and nested capture abstain.
Only direct row-field call arguments and simple scalar expression wrappers are supported.
Discarded call results cannot establish an input role; bare diagnostic or effect-only calls abstain.
Source call declarations must be unique, nonvariadic and return a value; source void assertion helpers are not input consumers.
Symmetric failure-guard operands have unresolved actual/expected roles and cannot alone establish an input consumer.
Import signatures are not a type or contract proof. Native controls and independent semantic audit remain necessary.
Field coupling, valid input domains, external effects, helper behavior and all untouched expectations require full-test review.
policy.novelty_boundary: Multirow pairing transformation with explicit column provenance. Existing literal edits can overlap individual cell changes.

novelty: Capability hypothesis: preserve all parameter rows and dynamic full-test observations while recombining input columns beyond the earlier two-region edit budget. Column rotation itself is established amplification; a contribution requires incremental valid detection and comparison with a capable generation baseline.
limitations: Only bounded original Go anonymous-struct tables with scalar literals and tracked direct uses.
Static input role does not prove subject identity, input independence or oracle validity.
The N06 corpus summaries had omitted final roundtrip equality. Recovering this information is necessary but not alone an algorithm contribution.

validation.scope: Core, exact multi-edit transport, complete-test preparation, source projection, raw provider replay, and native stopping/seal boundaries
